latest.title: Neil deGrasse Tyson | This Past Weekend w/ Theo Von #683
latest.desc:
Neil deGrasse Tyson is an astrophysicist, author and host. His latest book “Lost in Space: 5,000 Facts For Navigating the Universe” is out now.

Neil returns to talk about where he’d travel to in a wormhole, his thoughts on the billionaire space race, and what he’s asking aliens if they visit Earth.
